title: Juicy-Smoky Chinese Pig CharSiu Bao
description: A buttery, juicy showcase of soy sauce and binchotan charcoal cooking in a char-bao form, suitable for those who prefer to avoid onions and garlic.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, sugar, and five spice powder.
Wrap the seasoned pork in plastic wrap to prevent sticking and cook on a charcoal grill until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Mix soy sauce, oregano (if using), and a pinch of salt together for glaze. Glaze the cooked pork shoulder with this mixture before serving.
Divide the cooked pork into small portions, wrap in sheets of dough, and steam or bake until golden brown and cooked through.
